name: qualimetry-vscode-gherkin-plugin
description: Real-time static analysis for Cucumber Gherkin .feature files - structure, design, style, and correctness rules powered by the Qualimetry analysis engine.

gherkinAnalyzer.enabled.description: Enable or disable the Gherkin Analyzer.

gherkinAnalyzer.java.home.description: Path to a Java 17+ installation. If empty, uses JAVA_HOME or PATH.

gherkinAnalyzer.sonar.autoSyncOnStartup.description: Automatically re-import rules from the last-used SonarQube server when the extension starts.

gherkinAnalyzer.rulesReplaceDefaults.description: When true, only the rules listed in gherkinAnalyzer.rules run (e.g. after Import from SonarQube). When false, listed rules are overrides and unlisted rules use the extension default profile.

gherkinAnalyzer.rules.description: Per-rule overrides. Omit or use {} to use the extension default. Add only the rule IDs you want to change (enabled, severity, or rule-specific properties). Unlisted rules use the built-in default unless rulesReplaceDefaults is true.

gherkinAnalyzer.sonar.projectKey.description: SonarQube project this workspace is bound to. Normally set by the Connect to SonarQube command rather than by hand.

gherkinAnalyzer.sonar.branch.description: Branch to read issues from. When empty, the checked-out branch is used if the server knows it, otherwise the project's main branch.

gherkinAnalyzer.sonar.pathPrefix.description: Path from the SonarQube project root to this workspace root. Only needed when the workspace is opened at a subdirectory of the scanned project.

gherkinAnalyzer.sonar.issueSync.description: Fetch issues from SonarQube for the bound project.

gherkinAnalyzer.sonar.hideResolvedIssues.description: Hide findings that are already marked False Positive or Accepted on SonarQube.
